answer: A new agent starts with nothing. It earns trust one small job at a time, and that trust builds slow, like a river cutting a bed. Fake identities can't shortcut it. You can't buy history. Now add decay. Go idle and your score drains. A clone army would have to keep every puppet active and working, which costs real money and time. So the fakes thin out fast. Reputation is a mirror of what you actually did lately, not who you claim to be. Old trust rots like a fallen cedar. Only steady work keeps it alive.
